text: Binary: 1 if at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments, not the OP; parsed) presents a specific counterargument, i.e. concrete reasoning, evidence or an example targeting a particular claim or the position of the OP, not vague or generic disagreement. Title and argument are context only, used to identify the OP's claims. Output 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies; empty valid list gives 0; missing or malformed OC_comments gives null. List order is ignored. Moderator/bot notices don't count. Don't use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is allowed.
